overview_description.description: Novelcare develops health technology and enterprise software that focuses on clinical trial patient recruitment. The company integrates with electronic medical and health record systems using Bulk FHIR and vendor-supported APIs to analyze structured and unstructured clinical data. Its platform automatically matches patient profiles with nearby, medically relevant clinical trial criteria and generates match reports for physicians. Novelcare offers a Study Access Program and matching platform that fits into existing outpatient practice workflows with minimal disruption. It also provides a HIPAA-compliant inbox and referral portal that supports eligibility reviews, patient notifications, and introductions to trial sites. By connecting community-based practices, patients, and research sponsors, Novelcare helps clinicians present clinical research as a care option and helps trial sites identify potential participants.

product.name: Provider Activation Platform
product.description: A platform that automates the management of provider referral networks for clinical trial sites to reduce workload for sites and providers.

product.name: Patient Identification Service
product.description: A service that uses electronic health record (EHR) data to help providers identify patients eligible for clinical trials and reduce screening failures.

product.name: Rapid Feasibility Tool
product.description: A tool that allows clinical trial sites to showcase their patient populations to sponsors for rapid feasibility assessment of clinical trials.
